title: Synthetic mobile pet-check study

decision.question: Whether to run a two-week mobile home-check pilot for remote pet owners

target_users: People who leave a pet alone at home for four or more hours

hypotheses.statement: Remote pet owners with fixed-camera blind spots will accept a supervised mobile check
hypotheses.falsified_if: Privacy rejection persists after physical shutter, room boundary, and explicit-session controls are shown

stopping_rules: Stop after one full synthetic audit
Stop if the privacy falsifier is met
restart_rules: Restart only to test a changed privacy-control design
